intentions.title: Give Barkpark a dedicated single-tenant full-text search engine (Indx) as a swappable plugin behind the same search contract
intentions.evidence: client.ex documents the full Indx v5 HTTP surface (Login, CreateOrOpen, AnalyzeString, SetFieldConfiguration, LoadString, IndexDataSet, Search, GetJson, DeleteDataSet, per-record insert/update/delete); settings.ex resolves env > encrypted plugin_settings DB row > defaults so the engine is fully self-hosted and tenant-configurable; retriever.ex implements the plugin's search contract on top of the client.

intentions.title: Never corrupt or wedge the live search index during a rebuild — always rebuild into a fresh dataset and atomically swap
intentions.evidence: indexer.ex moduledoc: 'CRITICAL SYNC RULE (spike 2026-06-01): NEVER re-load an existing key onto a live indexed dataset — it HANGS and WEDGES the engine manager'; rebuild/3 always creates a fresh `<prefix>_<scope>_v<n>` dataset, and swap/2 is the sole atomic pointer flip; on any rebuild-step failure the fresh dataset is best-effort deleted so boot recovery never seats the live pointer on a partial dataset.

intentions.title: Support low-latency incremental index updates (upsert/delete) as a fast path alongside the safe full blue/green rebuild, with automatic fallback
intentions.evidence: Settings :incremental_upsert flag (default false, env INDX_INCREMENTAL_UPSERT); indexer.ex upsert_record/3 and delete_record/3 mutate the live dataset in place via stable-keyed insert/update/delete, explicitly called out as the ONE exception to 'never touch a live dataset'; indexer_worker.ex routes to a full rebuild whenever the engine reports {:reindex_required, _} or the live dataset/key_map is missing post-restart.

intentions.title: Make delete/update targeting exact and restart-safe via a deterministic, collision-resolved _id→numeric-key mapping that survives process restarts
intentions.evidence: key_for_id/1 (SHA-256-derived, 63-bit positive) plus render_corpus/1's deterministic linear collision probing keep the per-corpus key set injective; swap/2 records the resulting key_map and persists it via Persistence.save so Recovery/restore_pointer can reseat the :persistent_term live pointer after a restart wipes it; delete_record/3 reverse-looks-up the persisted map before falling back to the bare hash, emitting a telemetry/log signal when the fallback fires.

intentions.title: Debounce and serialize per-scope index churn so bursts of document saves collapse into one rebuild instead of one per document
intentions.evidence: indexer_worker.ex moduledoc: Oban worker unique on the scope partition key over a debounce window across available/scheduled/executing states; rebuild op is 'types-blind on purpose' — lists the WHOLE public corpus per scope so the blue/green swap never erases untouched types.

intentions.title: Never leak Indx credentials or bearer tokens into logs, error dumps, or telemetry
intentions.evidence: errors.ex defines a redaction policy scrubbing 'authorization' headers and token/password/userPassWord JSON keys via custom Inspect impls on AuthError/IndexError/SearchError/NetworkError, delegating to the shared Barkpark.Redaction engine; user_password is stored encrypted at rest via the plugin_settings row (settings.ex).

intentions.title: Make Indx outages and silent-fallback degradation observable to operators instead of presenting as ambiguous 'no results'
intentions.evidence: monitor.ex: 'the retriever falls back to empty results when the Indx engine is unreachable ... the user has no way to tell'; implements a per-scope ETS outcome counter (success/fallback/error, last_error_at/reason, fallback_rate) plus a canonical [:barkpark, :indx, :retriever, :outcome] telemetry event, exposed to bp doctor; table is self-bounding (wholesale clear at @max_rows) to avoid unbounded tenant-driven growth.

intentions.title: Keep the query path fast and safe by indexing a bounded, flattened, plain-text projection rather than raw nested document JSON
intentions.evidence: indexer.ex render_record/body_text: drops the raw :content JSONB (paper block trees up to 1.5MB timed out AnalyzeString), flattens to plain text via collect_text/2 skipping structural keys, and truncates to @body_max 4000 chars — with an explicit note that raising it to 8000 regressed BM25F ranking, so the cap is deliberate not a blind limit.
